Xveave Technologies - Xveave is pronounced "X-Weave". The name is weave with an X factor.

Your business is the differentiator. AI is the amplifier.

Helping organizations amplify what makes their business unique through AI-powered
enterprise products, SAP innovation, and bespoke solutions. Bespoke solutions,
AI-embedded platforms, and industry innovations on SAP and modern AI.

## Products

- DesignVeave (pronounced "Design Weave") - SAP implementation accelerator.
  A faster, structured, fully traceable S/4HANA design phase - workshops to sign-off.
  https://xveave.com/innovations/sap-implementation-accelerator.html

- AssortVeave (pronounced "Assort Weave") - AI-assisted assortment intelligence. Early access.
  Moulds to your assortment logic - decides what goes where, explains why, and
  simulates changes before you commit.
  https://xveave.com/innovations/ai-assortment-intelligence.html
